findings.title: Committed prompt/audit corpus bloats the repo and review surface
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: prompts/ is 626 tracked files / 9.43 MB (manifest pins 624 files / 8.9 MiB) and scripts/verify-prompts.js:29-31 still enforces the documented 640-file / 10 MiB budget; docs/audits is now 249 files / 5.86 MB and has its own documented advisory budget (docs/audits/README.md:75-90; scripts/check-audits-budget.mjs:30-32, but it is already over the 180-file ceiling - see HYGIENE-P3-014). Externalization remains an owner decision, so the corpus is bounded but still large.

The prompt-pack copies remain historical data under the provenance banner.

findings.title: Two Redis client libraries coexist in apps/api
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: apps/api/package.json:30 declares only ioredis ^5.11.1 (the redis ^4.7.0 dependency is gone); health/cache/idempotency and the worker all use ioredis.

findings.title: docs/audits corpus grows unbounded with no size or retention policy (prompts/ is budget-guarded, audits are not)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a: a policy and guard now exist - docs/audits/README.md:75-90 documents a 12-run / 180-file / 7 MiB budget and scripts/check-audits-budget.mjs:30-32 implements it in the shared unit-tests action (advisory, never fails by default). But the corpus already exceeds it: 11 run directories / 249 files / 5.86 MB against 12 / 180 / 7 MiB, and no runs have been archived. Because the guard is advisory by design and the file ceiling is the one being breached, growth is still effectively unbounded unless an operator acts; this run adds another ~45 files.

findings.title: docs/INDEX.md states two stale counts (11 ADRs vs 12, 75 module docs vs 74) and no guard covers them
findings.note: NEW at 6b7aa1a. docs/INDEX.md:28 says 'Architecture Decision Records (11 decisions)' but docs/adr/README.md:20-31 now has 12 rows (ADR-012, Redis-backed response cache, added 2026-10-12). docs/INDEX.md:141 says 'docs/modules/ - 75 files' but the directory contains 74 markdown files and the index links exactly 74 of them. scripts/check-docs-counts.mjs does not assert either count (it only covers AGENTS.md/README/test/migration/OpenAPI/a11y counts), and docs links pass because every link target exists. Impact: the docs landing page overstates the documentation inventory; readers/agents indexing it get a phantom file and a missing ADR. Recommendation: correct both cells and add the two counts to check-docs-counts.mjs.
